newsitem.title: USA: Puerto Rico Electric repriced, yields cut.
newsitem.headline: Puerto Rico Electric repriced, yields cut.

text.p: Bear, Stearns & Co., Inc. said Wednesday it repriced Puerto Rico Electric Power Authority's $129 million bond deal, lowering all maturities five basis points.
